# uzc_blockstorage_snapshot_revert (Resource)

Reverts a block storage volume to a snapshot (POST /blockstorages/{blockstorage}/snapshots/{blockstorage_snapshot}/revert) once on create and again whenever `triggers` changes. There is nothing to read back or clean up, so this resource exists purely to fire the revert action at a time the caller controls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reverts the volume once on create, and again any time a value in
# `triggers` changes.
resource "uzc_blockstorage_snapshot_revert" "example" {
  blockstorage          = uzc_blockstorage.example.slug
  blockstorage_snapshot = uzc_blockstorage_snapshot.example.slug

  triggers = {
    requested_at = timestamp()
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blockstorage` (String) Slug of the uzc_blockstorage volume that owns the snapshot.
- `blockstorage_snapshot` (String) Slug of the uzc_blockstorage_snapshot to revert to. Changing this forces a new revert.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value pairs. Changing any value fires the revert again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) An opaque identifier, unrelated to any UzCloud object.
